GoalOptions.Label: Technical Blueprint
GoalOptions.Text: To provide a comprehensive technical blueprint for re-architecting the Azure-hosted customer landing page. This document aims to detail the proposed cloud migration and scalability enhancements, ensuring all technical stakeholders understand the design choices and implementation strategy for achieving high availability and low latency.

GoalOptions.Label: Implementation Guide
GoalOptions.Text: To serve as a definitive implementation guide for junior developers and DevOps teams. This document will clearly outline the steps, configurations, and best practices required to deploy and manage the scalable web application, ensuring a smooth transition and operational efficiency post-migration.

GoalOptions.Label: Performance Optimization
GoalOptions.Text: To detail the architectural decisions and technical specifications necessary to resolve current capacity issues and achieve target non-functional requirements. This includes outlining strategies for elastic scalability, sub-200ms page load times, and 99.99% availability, ensuring a superior customer experience during peak traffic.

GoalOptions.Label: Risk Mitigation
GoalOptions.Text: To identify and mitigate potential technical risks associated with the cloud migration and scalability solution. This document will present a robust design that addresses failure points, ensures data integrity, and provides clear fallback mechanisms, safeguarding the customer landing page's continuous operation.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical & Performance Validation
Criteria: Solution design demonstrably achieves 99.99% availability for the customer landing page.
Proposed architecture ensures sub-200ms page load times under peak load conditions.
Design incorporates elastic scalability mechanisms capable of handling sudden 10x traffic spikes without degradation.
All critical Azure services and configurations are clearly defined and justified for performance targets.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Operational & Maintainability Readiness
Criteria: Deployment procedures are fully automated and documented for DevOps teams.
Monitoring and alerting solutions are integrated to detect and report capacity or performance issues proactively.
Solution design supports blue/green or canary deployments for zero-downtime updates.
Cost implications of the proposed Azure architecture are estimated and justified against performance gains.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Security & Compliance Adherence
Criteria: All data at rest and in transit for the landing page is encrypted using industry-standard protocols.
Access controls and identity management for Azure resources are clearly defined and follow least privilege principles.
Solution design incorporates DDoS protection and WAF for the public-facing landing page.
Compliance with relevant data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) is addressed in the data handling architecture.
